idea: Tesla Roadster does a rocket-thruster aerial flip off a ramp: a full 360-degree pitch flip and an upright landing
title: Rocket roadster flip
tagline: Can a 1.3 t car flip 360 deg on cold-gas thrusters and land upright?

agent_steps.label: Route idea to a physics template
agent_steps.summary: Template 'rocket_car' via explicit (matched: aerial, flip, ramp, roadster, rocket, tesla, thruster); keyword scores {'rocket_car': 7, 'humanoid_jump': 1}.

agent_steps.label: Research (curated catalog lookup)
agent_steps.summary: 10 curated catalog entries (7 verified, 3 unverified/unknown) from the offline catalog v2026-11-09. This is a curated, cited catalog — NOT live web research.

catalog.note: Hand-curated entries with source URLs. NOT live web research. verified=true means the figure was read in the cited page by the catalog author on checked_on; it does not make the source primary or the number a design fact.

entries.label: Vehicle weight target (2nd-gen Tesla Roadster, Top Gear walkaround as cited by Wikipedia)
entries.note: A target 'under 1,700 kg', not a measured production mass. The model default mass is a simplification and differs from this.

entries.label: Wheelbase
entries.note: Stated as 2,825 mm in the cited page.

entries.label: Cold-gas nozzles on the 'Rocket' variant
entries.note: Four rear nozzles (Thrust variant) plus six more at front and sides.

entries.label: Nitrogen COPV volume (Thrust variant)
entries.note: Rocket variant total 600 L per the same page.

entries.label: Stated duration of one full tank (Thrust variant)
entries.note: 'about five seconds' for a 0-60 mph run; says nothing about per-nozzle thrust.

entries.label: Specific impulse of cold-gas nitrogen
entries.note: Range from docs/judgment-spec.md R4 (marked unverified there). The cited page defines Isp for cold gas but the N2 figure was not confirmed by the catalog author.

entries.label: Per-nozzle thrust of the Tesla/SpaceX system
entries.note: No official figure known. The sweep over thruster_force_max exists because of this gap.

entries.label: Reference scale: NASA MMU cold-gas nozzle
entries.note: 24 N2 nozzles at 1.4 lbf each; shows how far a car-scale nozzle is from flown cold-gas hardware. Reference only, not used in the model.

entries.label: Model default vehicle mass
entries.note: Model default carried over from the roadster spike (spikes/roadster/REPORT.md); not sourced.

agent_steps.label: Assumptions panel (SpecSheet)
agent_steps.summary: 10 assumptions (6 low-confidence), 15 search parameters, 6 success criteria; overrides {'thruster_force_max': 5000.0}.

assumptions.source: default: spikes/roadster model; production mass unverified (target <1700 kg, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tesla_Roadster_(second_generation))

agent_steps.label: Necessary-condition screen
agent_steps.tool: analytic bounds (favorable assumption end) + MuJoCo inertia
agent_steps.summary: All necessary conditions pass (this proves nothing about feasibility) — flip_time_vs_air_time: 0.9669 vs limit 5.91 s -> PASS; propellant_mass: 1.223 vs limit 35 kg -> PASS

checks.name: flip_time_vs_air_time
checks.note: Min bang-bang rotation time (all pitch couples at full thrust) vs flight-time upper bound (all lift thrusters at full thrust, impulse-capped); evaluated at the favorable end of the assumptions (mass 5th pct, thrust +, Isp 95th pct, launch speed 95th pct). Nominal: 1.01 s vs 5.49 s.

checks.name: propellant_mass
checks.note: Lower bound on propellant from required angular impulse over the flight time (rocket equation, impulse form); evaluated at the favorable end of the assumptions (mass 5th pct, thrust +, Isp 95th pct, launch speed 95th pct). Nominal: 1.45 kg.

agent_steps.label: CMA-ES search
agent_steps.summary: Witness found after 3889 evaluations (7.0 s, 1 seed attempt(s)).

agent_steps.label: Monte-Carlo over assumptions
agent_steps.summary: Nominal optimum succeeds in 44/500 sampled assumption sets; failures: {'TIPPING': 390, 'STRUCTURAL_UNMODELED': 112, 'ENERGY_BUDGET': 151}.

agent_steps.label: Robustify against assumption spread
agent_steps.tool: cma-es on perturbed models + held-out MC
agent_steps.summary: Second CMA-ES stage on 24 perturbed models (43776 evals): held-out MC p 0.09 -> 0.13; robustified schedule adopted.

agent_steps.label: Export replay trajectory
agent_steps.summary: Replay rollout of the witness: 225 frames.

agent_steps.label: Optimizer-found fix (control sweep)
agent_steps.summary: (from the 2000 N variant run) Smallest feasible tested thruster_force_max: 3000 N (p_success 4%, verified by Monte-Carlo after 1 sweep variant(s)).

agent_steps.label: Bill of materials
agent_steps.summary: 4 BOM lines (0 priced; unpriced lines have no sourced cost).
